intro.text: The great demon of Mountaincrest, which came eight centuries ago feeding on souls until the Prophet defeated it and left a sword in its heart.
The great demon of Mountaincrest, held for centuries by the Prophet's sword, until it is set loose in Kingseat.
The great demon of Mountaincrest, set loose in Kingseat and then bonded by December, who reasons with it rather than trying to master it.

items.text: Some eight hundred years ago the Megalith appeared and devoured souls, driving people up into the mountains. Centuries on, the Prophet defeated it and left a sword in its heart, said to obey only his will and words.
Freed through the river of blood in the palace, it gathered over the building amid fire and panic. Petva tried to bring it under her control and was killed.
December reasoned with it instead of trying to dominate it and showed it mercy; it stopped raging and bonded with her.

appearance.text: A giant, skeletal, humanoid body as large as a city, lying against a mountain with Kingseat built around it; its heart feeds the kingdom's rivers of blood.
